description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to supervisor behavior, specifically providing access to exponential back-off configuration for Actor supervision within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: SupervisorConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for supervising actors, including method to retrieve exponential back-off configuration.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object for the exponential back-off strategy used in actor supervision.
